reviews.text: Very calm, understanding, positive and patient staff every time we've been there with our furry friend. Which is only twice now, but still 👍 …

Steer clear!
The website says they do root canals, which is why I chose them. The dog clearly had inflammation. There, two very young women took a picture of the dog's teeth with their phone and called another vet, who then referred us to Sem clinic because they wouldn't do it here. They didn't check the dog's temperature, nothing! After the consultation, she added the additional amount for a referral of 216 NOK to Sem clinic. Maridal clinic is very old, and the office looks terrible!

Steer clear!
Despite confirmation by email, no one knew about my class and I had to go home without having done what we came for.
It is also worth mentioning that there are only two parking spaces outside and both are occupied, presumably by employees.

Professional, experienced and knowledgeable veterinarian. Thorough examinations. Good descriptions of the disease, course of the disease, symptoms, investigation and the way forward. Both owner and dog are very well taken care of. Highly recommended😊 …

I accidentally contacted this clinic for help on New Year's Eve. Even though the clinic was closed, I received answers, advice, and help with my pet's problems. I've never dealt with such a good and professional vet. If you live in the area, go there. Thank you ❤️

I have had my dog ​​for 2.5 years and now she is unfortunately sold. Which I really regretted. But we went to Maridalsveien smpdyrklinink to cut nails and get vaccines and I am very happy with them. He was on time every time and very skilled
Veterinarian Freddy is a very knowledgeable and experienced veterinarian. He is very good with animals, provides good and thorough information and guidance. Recommended!
Thorough examination, good help and clarification of the diagnosis on a Saturday
Professional and empathetic veterinarian who clearly loves animals very much

We have a difficult dog. A Shiba.
Most vets get the chills and don't dare touch Shibas.

Freddy is incredibly professional, fearless, and has a warm heart. We have been to a number of vets throughout, but have stayed with Freddy.
Both animals and owners are well taken care of! Glad I brought my kitty Isma here

Very good service as usual. Great help both on the phone and in the clinic when our Jack Russel, Gåte, injured all four paws in a stone watch. Super treatment. Avoid chain vets like the plague and go here instead. 👏🙃 …
Good service and good price, our vet professionally approached my Shiba Inu for the check up and gave good recommendations.
Very happy with the vet who showed up quickly and got the dog's eye problems sorted. Pleasant and skilled vet. Thumbs up
